newsitem.title: FINLAND: ALANDSBANKEN SETS FIM 100 MLN 10-YR BOND.
newsitem.headline: ALANDSBANKEN SETS FIM 100 MLN 10-YR BOND.

text.p: Finnish Bank Alandsbanken AB said in a statement on Friday it planned to issue a 100 million markka 10-year convertible bond with a fixed annual interest rate, which it said was likely to be around 5.7 percent.
Every bond with a nominal value of 10,000 markka can be converted from August 24, 1998 to 100 Alandsbanken preferred shares. "The conversion price is 100 markka per share," the bank said.
At 1130/0930 GMT, Alandsbanken's preferred share traded at 98.00 markka, down 1.00.

The fixed annual interest rate on the bond would be decided by the board on March 20, Alandsbanken said. The coupon would be the yield on the government benchmark 2006 bond reduced by 10-30 basis points, it said.
The subscription period would be April 2 to 18, 1997.
